entities.summary: Red Turban Rebellion, a transformative movement in China (1294–1368). Emerged from Two failed Mongol invasions of Japan destroyed by typhoons ('kamikaze') and Yuan. Catalyzed Yuan Decline and Red Turban Rebellion and Ming.
